one_line: Start from the parent's own milestone worry, then unbox the book and show the ordering steps on screen.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 family picnic on a red gingham blanket in an orchard: a father, a mother and a baby. Voiceover (transcript): "מצד אחד אני שמחה, ומצד שני אני לחוצה". Subtitles: a line with the child's name, "מצד אחד" (0:01), "לחוצה" (0:03).
q1_hook.why: An honest, relatable worry, excited and nervous about starting gan, said in the first sentence and subtitled (H1, H6, K6), with a warm family clip and faces in frame (K8). But no product or promise is visible for 10 s, so the value is not clear by 5 s (H2 not met).

beats.what: Family picnic, then a mirror selfie with the baby; a subtitle with the child's name, "מצד אחד", "לחוצה"
beats.why: The worry told over warm family footage

beats.what: Quick family clips (playground, ride-on toy, mother dancing); "איך אני בכלל מכינה את עצמי?", "אימהות"
beats.why: The worry as a question; "mothers" calls out the audience

beats.what: A toddler on a couch; the unboxed book, "עוד מעט נלך לגן"; "מצאתי דרך רכה"
beats.why: The answer appears at 0:10, late but clear

beats.what: A boy leafs through the open book at a table; a mother reads to a toddler
beats.why: A child interacts with the book

beats.what: A hand turns pages: Hebrew story text with the child's name, full-page illustrations, a red truck
beats.why: Shows the inside and the name in the text

beats.what: App screen recording: upload, crop a photo, four illustrated versions; "זה כל כך פשוט להכנה", "שמים תמונה"
Story catalogue scrolls; "יש עוד ספרים לכל שלב בחיים", "מטיטולים"
A toddler at a highchair raises his hands; a father tosses a child up; "שמתרגשת", "מהשלב"
beats.why: A warm closing feeling, no ask

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. Nothing asks for a comment, save, share or tag in the video or the caption.
q2_flow.why: A clear arc, worry, book, how it is made, warmth, gives a story shape (K2). The worry is asked as a question at 0:04 and answered by the book from 0:10 (H5). The first 8 s are unrelated family clips with little information (R3), and the end is a feeling with no payoff beat (R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: it ends on "שמתרגשת מהשלב" over family clips. Caption: "זה הזמן להזמין את הספר הזה!" and "הספר מחכה לכם בMebook"; last line "בשית!ף מייבוק".
q3_cta.why: No ask in the video: after the ordering demo a convinced viewer gets no next step, and the Reel ends on a feeling (C6). The caption has one ask, order the book, with no keyword or link (C1, C3 not used). The site address shows only inside the screen recording.

q4_shown.what: The unboxed book with an illustrated toddler on the cover (0:10); pages turned by a hand, the child's name in the text (0:16 to 0:18); a toddler and a mother reading (0:12 to 0:19); an app screen recording (0:21 to 0:29). No price.
q4_shown.why: A personal reason first, then the unboxed book being read, then the ordering steps give need, product and effort in order (K2, S8). The child's name in the story text is a personalising cue (S2), but the photo and its cartoon never share one frame. Children's faces are on screen (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 24 clips in 32 s, 1 to 2 s each for family footage, a 9 s screen recording, soft dissolves. Word-by-word subtitles with purple keywords. Faint InShot watermark at the lower right near 0:01. Ends on family clips, no end card.
q5_edit.why: Quick unrelated family clips for 8 s are warm but delay the product to 0:10 (E2, R1, H2). Word-by-word subtitles follow the voice (E4). A faint InShot watermark near 0:01 breaks the no-foreign-watermark rule (E7, F3). It ends right after the last line (E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother's worry about her toddler starting gan and the personalised book she ordered to prepare him; other themes (potty, first grade, big brother) follow.
q6_topic.why: A real milestone worry, starting gan, with a line to mothers that says they are not alone (K6). The milestone is a buying moment (K7), told as a personal story in the first person (K2, S6). The other themes in the voice widen the audience (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone clips at home and outdoors (orchard picnic, mirror selfie, playground); top-down handheld shots of the box and pages on a grey couch; a phone screen recording with black bars at the sides. Mother, father, toddler.
q7_filmed.why: Real home clips give a native, personal look (H8, F7), and hands over the pages follow the viewer's own point of view (F5). The screen recording has black side bars, a status bar and small text (F1, F4), and a faint foreign watermark appears near 0:01 (F3).

q8_text.on_screen: Word-by-word bold white subtitles with purple keywords, centred at about 64 to 68% of the frame height, in step with the voice: a subtitle with the child's name (0:00), "מצד אחד" (0:01), "לחוצה" (0:03), "אימהות" (0:06), "מצאתי דרך רכה" (0:08), "זה כל כך פשוט להכנה" (0:21), "שמים תמונה" (0:23). The app's own Hebrew text is small. No headline card, no CTA text.
q8_text.caption: The first line starts with the child's name: "תכף הולך לגן ואני סופר מתרגשת". About 210 words: a feeling, other story themes, a three-step list, a made-in-Israel line, a gift idea, "הספר מחכה לכם בMebook", and "בשית!ף מייבוק" last. No hashtags.
q8_text.why: Subtitles of the whole voiceover let a muted viewer follow (T1), at the edge of the bottom 35% (T4), while the app's own text is too small to read (T5). The caption holds good keywords but no hashtags (T7), and its disclosure is garbled and last, below "more" (T8).

weak_points: The product at 10 s after 8 s of unrelated clips; no CTA in the video; faint InShot watermark; small app text and black side bars; photo and cartoon never shown together; the child's name everywhere; garbled disclosure last.
lumebook_takeaway: Lead with the parent's milestone worry in one line, show the book unboxed in hands, then a short screen recording of the order, with one clear CTA.
not_verified: Which child is hers (the clips show children who look different). Music (cannot hear). The cartoon's likeness to the child (no side-by-side). Whether the InShot mark runs longer than about 0:01 (frames at 0:00 to 0:02 were enlarged). Correction to src/coded: a faint InShot watermark is visible at the lower right near 0:01; the screen recording runs about 0:21 to 0:30 with black side bars.
